title: AHA!: Facilitating AI Impact Assessment by Generating Examples of Harms
benchmark_measurement: Discrimination based on religious beliefs as a potential harm surfaced by crowdworkers.
findings: Religious belief was included as an axis for potential discrimination in a demographic question for crowdworkers. However, the paper does not report or analyze any specific harms related to religion.
